rv.q: How the Grinch Stole Christmas! The Musical can easily make any Grinch’s heart grow and will wipe all your “bah humbug’s” away.
The set is a beautiful homage to the artistry of Dr. Seuss’ original text.

cn.t: Critics agree this holiday classic delivers pure seasonal joy, with its vibrant Whoville spectacle earning high praise as a perfect family tradition. A festive crowd-pleaser that earns its place as a must-see Christmas staple.
